agent_redesign.name: Re-plan-per-step
agent_redesign.rationale: Static plan-then-execute caused 50-66% wasted LLM calls. Each PLAN call now sees freshest screenshot + step history, returns 1 action or done: true. Verification is implicit (next PLAN observes new screen).
agent_redesign.state_machine: INIT -> PLAN (screenshot+LLM) -> EXECUTE (1 action) -> VERIFY (no-op) -> PLAN (re-plan) -> ... -> COMPLETE

user.text: USER TASK: ... STEPS COMPLETED: ... decide next action or done: true

system_prompts.CHAT_ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT: Used when vision_mode=False. VDA persona, Hinglish-friendly, no JSON, no fabricated actions.
system_prompts.DESKTOP_AUTOMATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT: Used when vision_mode=True. Re-plan-per-step design with done: true field.

uat_issues.name: Chat-mode latency / empty responses
uat_issues.fix: Controller short-circuits agent loop for chat messages (no vision mode). Uses CHAT_ASSISTANT_SYSTEM_PROMPT. Fallback _on_agent_finished() calls LLM directly if agent returns no usable text.

uat_issues.fix: Re-plan-per-step design (commit 42af509). 1 LLM call per step, screenshot-based re-planning, done: true for completion.

decisions.rationale: Each PLAN call sees fresh screenshot + step history. Cuts LLM calls 50-66%. Verification is implicit (next PLAN observes new screen).

decisions.decision: Dual system prompts selected by vision_mode flag
decisions.rationale: Chat persona (Hinglish, conversational) is wrong for vision mode (JSON actions). User-facing responses should never contain JSON or fabricated actions.
Greetings/questions/translations don't need agent loop. Skip directly to LLM call with chat prompt when vision_mode=False and message looks like chat.
Prevents cross-provider credential leakage. Old code had single 'api_key' key that returned NVIDIA key for OpenCode Zen requests causing 401.

decisions.decision: OpenCode Zen anonymous = no Authorization header at all
decisions.rationale: Server rejects 'Bearer public' (tested: 401). Empty Authorization omitted entirely.
Reduces image bytes ~70% (vs 1920x1080 PNG), saves LLM tokens, faster transmission.
Re-plan model needs more headroom. Old 10 limit was for static plans (fewer LLM calls).
Bounds token usage across long agent runs while keeping recent context.
